'''Chompers the Undying''' was the trained [[K'lor'slug/Legends|K'lor'slug]] of [[Conraad Om'wurt]], a gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] Conraad was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]" and was defeated in the fourth round of the Arena fights along with Chompers.

==Behind the scenes==
Chompers the Undying appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the fourth boss fight of "Eternal Championship".
